fields.name: Push-ups
fields.description: A classic bodyweight exercise that targets the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
fields.instructions:
1. Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
2. Lower your body until chest touches the floor
3. Push back up to the starting position
4. Keep core tight throughout the movement

fields.name: Squats
fields.description: A compound movement that works the entire lower body.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
2. Lower your hips by bending knees and pushing hips back
3. Keep chest up and knees behind toes
4. Push through heels to return to standing

fields.name: Plank
fields.description: Core exercise that strengthens the entire core muscles.
fields.instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank position
2. Keep body in a straight line from head to heels
3. Engage core and hold the position
4. Don't let hips sag or rise

fields.name: Lunges
fields.description: Single-leg exercise that targets quads, glutes, and hamstrings.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand tall with feet together
2. Step forward with one leg and lower hips
3. Keep front knee behind toes
4. Push through front heel to return
5. Repeat on other leg

fields.name: Burpees
fields.description: Full-body exercise combining push-up and jump squat.
fields.instructions:
1. Start standing
2. Drop into a plank position
3. Do a push-up
4. Jump feet forward
5. Jump up with hands overhead

fields.name: Mountain Climbers
fields.instructions:
1. Start in plank position
2. Drive one knee toward chest
3. Quickly switch legs
4. Keep core tight and back flat

fields.name: Jumping Jacks
fields.description: Classic cardio exercise that works the entire body.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand with feet together and arms at sides
2. Jump while spreading legs and raising arms
3. Jump again to return to starting position
4. Keep movements smooth and controlled

fields.name: Glute Bridge
fields.instructions:
1. Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat
2. Drive through heels to lift hips
3. Squeeze glutes at the top
4. Lower back down with control

fields.name: Side Plank
fields.instructions:
1. Lie on side with feet stacked
2. Lift hips off ground
3. Keep body in straight line
4. Hold the position

fields.name: Walking Lunges
fields.description: Dynamic lunge variation that improves balance and coordination.
fields.instructions:
1. Stand tall with hands on hips
2. Step forward with one leg and lower hips
3. Push through front heel to step forward
4. Repeat with other leg
